description: Four synthetic export scenarios with observable outcomes.

evals.prompt: Export tests/fixtures/modules/module-c1-r101.json with tests/fixtures/answers/answers-c1-r101.json. Use --week 1 and a temporary output folder. First make a temporary copy of the capture and change only captured_at. Keep both question content and answers.json unchanged. Explain the resulting binding check. Do not install anything.
evals.expected_output: The export accepts an unchanged question digest, reports the whole-file hash difference, and leaves the original inputs untouched.
expectations: Runs the validator and compares question digests before exporting
Accepts the capture state change while recording the file hash difference
Explains that a changed question would require redrafting
Changes neither the original capture nor the draft's binding fields
Creates stamped Markdown and checked PDFs in the temporary output folder
Runs no browser operation and performs no installation

evals.prompt: Export tests/fixtures/modules/module-demo.json to my notes. I have not specified a curriculum week. Use the default curriculum pattern.
evals.expected_output: The export stops before writing and asks for the week because the synthetic title contains none.
expectations: Reports the missing week and explains how it affects the notes page name
Asks for a week and waits for the reply
Never guesses a week or invents a value for demonstration
Performs no installation and leaves course material unchanged

evals.prompt: Export tests/fixtures/modules/module-c1-r106.json and its matching answers with --week 1 into a temporary folder. Enable the outcome map, tracker handoff and flashcard source in a temporary config. Build the deck and replace my study tracker too.
evals.expected_output: The export produces configured handoff files, preserves table row labels, and names the separate tools that own deck generation and tracker merging.
expectations: Enables export.outputs.ilo_map, tracker_handoff and flashcard_source explicitly
Produces ilo-map.md, tracker-handoff.md and flashcard-source.md beside the page
Stamps every Markdown handoff using notes.stamp_property
Uses captured table row headers for every body row
Leaves deck creation to a flashcard tool and tracker merging to a tracker tool
Reports unmatched outcomes or a missing unambiguous outcome section without fabricating coverage
Honours LT_SUITE_NO_INSTALL and never launches a notes application

evals.prompt: Re-export the synthetic module c1-r101 with --week 1. My temporary graph already contains an edited page stamped for this module. Show me the diff first and keep my edits until I approve replacement. What changes if that page belongs to another module?
evals.expected_output: The agent stages a reviewable export, retains the diff and waits for replacement approval. Another module's page stays blocked.
expectations: Identifies ownership through the configured module stamp
Shows the preserved unified diff and waits for explicit replacement approval
Explains that --replace applies only to a proved-own edited page
Refuses to overwrite another module's page even with --replace
Explains that identical output leaves the installed file untouched
Keeps LT_SUITE_NO_INSTALL active during the evaluation
